dataset: 669 S669 endpoint pairs, 87 full-length WT sequences
path: Introduce m=N/2 temporary changes at distinct non-target sites, apply target change, revert temporary changes in reverse order
random_rule: Uniform non-target standard-AA positions within fixed window; replacement uniform among 19 non-WT residues
windows: Identical mutation-centered windows as existing S669 results, length <=1022
msa: Existing MMseqs2 + HHfilter id90 diff1000 cov0 qid0 qsc-20; same homologs/order/depth in all states; 16000 tokens
encoder: Published frozen MSA Transformer layer12; FP32; dropout disabled
pooling: Published query pooling, excluding initial token and final real residue
